title: Prod deploy blocked by an explicit deny in an SCP
scenario: The v2.6.0 prod CDK deploy rolled back: CloudFormation could not create an IAM role because of an explicit deny in a service control policy. A new SCP exempts the GitLab deploy roles, so on-call blames a permissions boundary. Trace who really made the call and fix the SCP without weakening it.
task: Read the CloudTrail record and the CDK assume chain
Replay the calls through the org policies with the evaluator
Fix the exemption with the smallest change
acceptance: Exec role allowed; deploy roles, developers and look-alikes denied
No blanket exemption; org guardrails still hold
ANSWER.md names the CloudFormation execution role with evidence
